articleTitle: One New Method to Solve Time-Cost Tradeoff Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Time-cost tradeoff problem is one core problem in project scheduling, and also is one difficult problem which project manager have to face. Methods of solving the problem mainly contain method of network flow and method of mending the minimal cost. There into, for the method of mending the minimal cost are intuitionistic, convenient and lesser computation, these advantages make the method being used widely in practice. But disadvantage of the method is that the result of each step is optimal but the terminal result maybe not optimal. In this paper, method of reducing duration directly is designed on the basis of the method of mending the minimal cost, and the result of solving time-cost tradeoff problem is more optimized.

articleTitle: A Compiler for Group Key Exchange Protocol to Resist Insider Attack in Universally Composable Framework
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The problem of group key exchange protocol to resist insider attack has been widely analyzed and studied. But in universally composable framework, there are not compilers which can directly compile a group key exchange protocol to the protocol which can resist insider attack yet. So this paper designs and analyzes this kind of compilers in universally composable framework, and proves that the protocols from the our compilers are secure to resist insider attack.

articleTitle: MIP-Guided Blood Vessel Segmentation Using SEM Statistical Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Blood vessel segmentation is an essential step of the diagnoses of various brain diseases. In this paper, we propose a novel method for segmentation of cerebral blood vessels from magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) images based on Gaussian Mixture Model and the SEM algorithm. First the MIP algorithm is applied to decrease the quantity of mixing elements. Then the Gaussian Mixture Model is put forward to fit the stochastic distribution of the brain vessels and other tissue. Finally, the SEM algorithm is adopted to estimate the parameters of Gaussian Mixture Model. The feasibility and validity of the model is verified by the experiment. With the model, small branches of the brain vessel can be segmented, the speed of the convergent is improved and local minima are avoided and the accuracy of segmentation is improved by the random assortment iteration. Our method is tested on head MRA datasets, it is demonstrated to be efficient.

articleTitle: Performance on SK-Coverage in WSN of the Forest Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: K-coverage algorithm is widely used in wireless sensor networks (WSN) of the forest fire detection and monitoring system. However, the sensing ability of a sensor node is non-uniform in all directions in shadowed environments. So, the optimized algorithm (SK-coverage) should be well proposed in this paper. The reliability of the collected data and the network lifetime are paid close attention to by the algorithm. The simulation result shows that the algorithm can supply the network with higher reliable collected data all long and low whole network energy consumption, compared with the former k-coverage algorithms, which do not consider the shadowed factors for the sensor nodes.

articleTitle: Research of Series CNC High Speed Endface Cylindrical Grinder
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: CNC system based on Siemens AG SINUMERIK820-core used for processing control of MKS1632 high-speed cylindrical grinding machine is designed. The mechanism of high speed spindle is that the motor and spindle are combined as one body, rapid feedrate is realized by steeplead ball screw and increasing feed servo motor rotation speed, the wear particles of wheel are mainly of cubic Boron Nitride and diamonds, and the machine is more stable and reliable. The CNC grinding machine can be realized in the three-axis CNC & successive feed of the two-axis, and the accurately digital control of contour evolution and radically flowing. The practice indicates that the system have strong extensibility, fast response time, high precision of recognition etc. feature. The efficiency of external cylindrical grinder and degree of automation is greatly raised.

articleTitle: Attribute Reduction Algorithm and the Generation of Hybrid Decision Tree Based on Discernibility Matrix in Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through the use of the Discernibility Matrix in Rough Set, this paper introduced an Attribute Reduction Algorithm, based on which, a new one is put forward about the Generation of Hybrid Decision Tree. This Algorithm improved the traditional method as the attributes with high frequency of occurrence in the Discernibility Matrix can classify more examples at a time. Finally, by the comparison between the Algorithm and ID3, the new Algorithm is proved to be more superior and advantageous.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Process Definition Tool
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With each passing day of enterprise business, work flow needs to be improved frequently, which proposes high requirements to the process definition tool. Through briefly introducing the concept of workflow and workflow management system, the foundational and importance of process definition has been pointed out in the workflow management system. Finally, giving the Design and Implementation of Process Definition Tool.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Web-Online English Testing System
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of the Information Technology and communication technology, considerable progress has also been made in the development of education information. Owing to the cumbersome and inefficient work of traditional English exam, in order to reduce English teachers' workload, improve their efficiency and optimize examination process, this paper designs and develops an online English examination system based on J2EE platform, with the application of Struts framework, which is cross-platform, functional, safe and stable. The system is divided into front test function module and acquired management module, using MVC design pattern and the connection pool technology, which can greatly improve system's maintainability and reusability.

articleTitle: Chaos Attractor Compressing and Expanding in Chua Circuit Driven by Direct Current Voltage
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The dynamics of Chua circuit driven by the direct current voltage is explored experimentally. The increasing direct current voltage (DCV) breaks the centro-symmetry in the Chua circuit, so that the attractor basin of one of the coexisting attractors shrinks with that of the other one expanding. Finally, only the expanding attractor exists with the shrinking one disappear for a critical DCV intensity. Its regime is presented for the symmetry break caused by the DCV.

articleTitle: On Boolean Index Sets of Cn x P3(n=0,1,2(mod6))
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, using the constrcutive skills of edge labeling function, we detremine the maximum edge-balance index and its edge-balance index sets of Cn x P3(n=0,1,2(mod6)).

articleTitle: The Fault Diagnosis Based on Immune Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Information model for complex equipment fault in space exist serious overlap problem, the author proposed a fault diagnosis based on immune neural network, this method gives a combination of immune algorithm and neural network's edge. Simulation results show that the method can improve diagnosis ability to complex fault diagnosis model.

articleTitle: The Characteristic of Phenomenon-Fractal in Enterprise Business
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this article, fractal dimensions about volume of enterprise business are calculated with the box dimensions method. And separately, the relationship between those fractal dimensions and fractal characteristic of Enterprise business is discussed. The result shows that fractal dimensions can be represent the production characteristics. some scholar would disagree with the investigation of the enterprise business problem, in fact, production process embodies the extensive principles information about the enterprise business. Fractal dimension, our new solution for collaborative algorithms, is the solution to all of these issues. the dimension has been calculated about the process of business, and the Fractal geometry offered the quantitative description method for this kind of phenomenon.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Performance Monitoring Tool for Clustered Streaming Media Server Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As Video-on-Demand (VoD) services become popular and clusters are widely-used for delivering streaming media data, it is critical and important to monitor, control and manage servers and various resources. To address this issue, we present a performance monitoring tool used for such cluster-based VoD service systems, which can monitor resources such as CPU utilization, memory usage, disk usage and network bandwidth from time to time on demand. The design of the monitoring tool enables certain flexibility and extensibility to scale up. Monitoring data are encapsulated and stored in different databases for future use. Information will be displayed in the format of charts generated from the graph database, and will be refreshed within specified interval. Experiments based on a prototype system demonstrate that the tool we developed can measure and collect necessary data as needed and then visualize them by certain charts, exhibiting feasibility and good usability.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Coordination Based on the Information Asymmetry and Virtual Third Party
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Information asymmetry widely exists in the supply chain. The supply chain cannot be coordinated easily because of it. But coordination is important to maximize the profit of supply chain. In this paper, the situation that supplier has adverse selection and the retailer has moral hazard for information asymmetry is considered. A virtual third party is introduced to develop an incentive model from the perspective of supply chain. The result shows that this method can coordinate the supply chain under information asymmetry. And the model is proved to be the same as that in real world.

articleTitle: A Methodology Using Partial Swarm Optimization and Kriging to Ship Multidisciplinary Design Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Ship optimization design is a complex multidisciplinary process due to determining ship configuration variables that satisfy a set of mission requirements. In this paper A Monte Carlo method (MCM) is employed to explore the design space and to sample data for covering the design space. Particularly in ship multidisciplinary design optimization, we investigate the use of kriging sampling methods for constructing global approximations and fit model to facilitate multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO). In this search (MDO) are used to computational expense and organizational complexity, Partial Swarm Optimization (PSO) adopt as a feasible alternative to the existing sizing and optimization methods and to illustrate the appropriate design result in approach through (MDO) process, the objective of this search to minimum ship running cost which it subjected to constraints in performance, geometric parameters, power of population and voyage. Finally, the validity of the proposed methodology is proven by a case study of a bulk carrier.

articleTitle: Research on Methods to Fast Eliminate Singular Value in Irregular Initial Measured Displacement Serial
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to analyze vary interval measured displacement serial, the fast and effectively method to eliminate singular value is build. Firstly, the singular value is initiatively judged and eliminated by logical analysis method, then uncertain filtering method is improved to fast eliminate singular value based on feature of measured displacement. Examples show the variation trend and measured value character of initial value can well be retained, and singular value of initial value can be effectively eliminated fast and simply while true signal (abnormal value) can be reserved effectively. So these treatment methods can provide with reliable analysis date for the successor research based on the dealt measured displacement.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Coordination Model of Green Remanufacturing with Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model is developed to analyze supply chain coordination consisted of a manufacturer and an outsourcer in green remanufacturing. On condition that allowing manufacturer delay in payment, we build an objective function of optimal profit of supply chain in different outsourcing degree. And further research several parameters such as time of delay-in-payment, cost of products from outsourcer to manufacturer to explore their influence to optimal profit . Find the best coordination strategy to supply chain about those parameters. Numerical examples are illustrated the efficacy of the developed model and the procedure developed for solving the problem.

articleTitle: One Improvement Algorithm of Solving Time-Cost Tradeoff Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a new algorithm is designed to solve time-cost tradeoff problem. Conventional algorithm is to reduce length of longer paths in activity network first, and then reduce shorter ones step by step. The contrary idea is adopted in the paper, firstly, the activity network is simplified equivalently by using theory of network planning technology and float, and paths which should be considered in network are found out, which could realize effect of simplifying objective and reducing quantity of computation, secondly, the shortest paths of these paths are reduced, and then longer ones are reduced step by step until all length of longer paths are reduced to appointed length, viz. the total duration, and finally, circs of whether reducing is excessive is judged by checking whether float of activities with reduced duration are zero, and method of modification is designed, which could help to give reasonable scheme and result of solving the problem.

articleTitle: Index Tracking Method Based on the Bootstrap Simulation Technology and Its Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The assets allocation approach of the index tracking portfolio is one of the important factors for the performance of index tracking. In this paper, the Bootstrap simulation technology is used to improve the structure of assets allocation of index tracking portfolio, which is depended on the optimized index tracking method, for the better performance of index tracking. The empirical results shows that the performance of index tracking based on the Bootstrap simulation technology is better than that of the optimization method. The main advantage of the index tracking method based on the Bootstrap simulation technology is that it can tackle the index tracking problem as complex as it is, generating accurate and robust results.

articleTitle: Model Design of Information Security Monitoring System of Nanchang Bonded Logistics Park
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since the network security arises more and more attention, many network systems, particularly the large ones, have adopted the appropriate security management preventions, which have increased the difficulty of intrusions to network/system by network/system software or hardware security breaches. For the large computer network system of Nanchang Bonded Logistics Park, the paper tries to integrally consider the features of normal state and intrusion, uses the composite intrusion detection bases to establish a simple but effective security monitoring system based on self-adapting statistical method in order to detect and report the network attacks.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Index of Streamline Dynamic Successive Trees
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on Streamline Dynamic Successive Trees, the paper proposes a dynamic index update method which update size is in character-level, The document-level index update algorithm and the character-level index update algorithm are based on SDST, and the performance of these 2 algorithms are compared, The efficiency of the character-level index update method is proved by experiment. The result shows that the performance of character-level update method is better than document-level.

articleTitle: A Novel Blind Equalization Algorithm for QPSK Signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a novel SVM-SCA algorithm combining support vector machines(SVM) with square contour algorithm(SCA). The proposed algorithm sets the initial weights of the blind equalizer by means of SVM and then switches to SCA algorithm which has a lower computational complexity. The simulation results demonstrate that the SVM-SCA algorithm converges much faster, gains better ISI performance and is more steady compared with the traditional blind equalization based on SCA.

articleTitle: Image Information Hiding Based on CGH of Phase-Only Interference Holography
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An image information hiding technique based on computer-generated hologram (CGH) of phase-only interference holography is proposed to significantly improve the traditional method. The importance of the phase in transformation is analyzed. Compared with the traditional method, the phase-only wave instead of complex function of the traditional Fourier-transformed object wave, which then is used to interfere with the reference wave and a high contrast CGH is obtained. The hologram is encrypted by security key and is superposed on discrete-cosine-transform domain of the host image. In the detection stage, the original information is extracted based on optical or digital inverse Fourier transform with the security key. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the improved method received better robustness than traditional information hiding technology based on CGH.

articleTitle: Ring Waterside Line Information Extraction Method of Mudflat in the Yangtze River Estuary
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Waterside line information extraction is a foundation work in studying mudflat sedimentation/erosion change. The paper proposed a new identification method which, compared with the traditional Hough-like method, is suitable for the ring waterside line detection. Firstly, the image segmentation was performed to realize the edge detection based on the waterside line gray gradient information. And then, the mathematical morphology method was run to dilate and fill the interior edges. Furthermore, a continuous and smooth waterside line could be obtained by constructing segment-shaped structural elements. At last, an experiment was carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness and simplicity of the method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Fault Diagnosis Based on One Advanced Discernibility Function Reduction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Rough sets theory can eliminate the redundant and imprecise information effectively and correctly in fault diagnosis, which improve the real time and has much advantage of transforming afterwards and regular equipment logistics support to real-time logistics support. So the research on equipment fault diagnosis based on rough sets theory has much signification. The paper applies one advanced reduction algorithm based on discernibility function to some aero radio equipment's fault diagnosis according to the deficiency of familiar attribution reduction algorithm based on discernibility function. The results show the algorithm can not only diagnose effectively and correctly but save much time.

articleTitle: Research on Segmentation in Deleting Repeat Questions
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is an effective method that deletes repeat questions to provide quality of question bank. The main way is semantic similarity computing to solve repeat questions deleting but which depends on correct segmentation of text. A highly efficient and accurate method to segment words is proposed which combines word segmentation based on dictionary with reverse maximum matching and based on statistics with suffix arrays. And the idea references design of memory. The accuracy of word segmentation may achieve 97% and have 10% of increase in constructing question bank for principles of computer organization.

articleTitle: NH4+-N and NO3- -N Space Trend Surface Analysis Based on MATLAB Software
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using soil pollution model to evaluate water and soil pollution's mathematic modeling is a powerful tool in the evaluation work. Based on powerful data analysis software-MATLAB platform, we analyzed the spatial variability of NH4+-N and NO3 -- N desorption in soil polluted by rare earth leaching. Through the analysis of trend surface, we understood the spatial distribution of NH4+-N and NO3 -- N and noticed that this variation is quite distinct across the depth of the polluted soil.

articleTitle: On the Random Disturbance Term and Parameter Estimation of C-D Production Function
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cobb - Douglas production function occupies an important position in econometrics and has a wide range of applications, but the representation of its random disturbance term and the method used for its parameter estimation are open to question. Using mathematical and statistical analysis method, this paper discusses the random disturbance term of C-D production function and data processing methods. Also, a practical example for testing is showed. As a result, we get a new approach for parameter estimation, which are more reasonable and more accurate.

articleTitle: Transient Response Measurement System of Ultrasonic Motors
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The characteristic of transient response is an important parameter for ultrasonic motors. The transient response measuring system is mostly composed of ARM and a photoelectric encoder and a digital oscilloscope. The design principle and structure of the measuring system and the realization of process are introduced. The validity of the test system is verified through the testing results.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of LDPC Codec for Aircraft Control and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The system is based on the platform of Altera DE2 SOPC and RS232 interface using a wireless channel environment. NIOS_II processor and FPGA hardware co-design methodology is adopted. The soft-core processor asks for a request to send codec allocation and other operations and FPGA is responsible for the major hardware codec. The LDPC codec system can achieve a two-way communication with flexible configuration, which is particularly suitable for satellite communications.

articleTitle: A Content-Based Relevance Feedback Model for Product Review Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Product review is a kind of useful information on the web. This paper describes a relevance feedback model based on modifying relation for that information retrieval, which utilizes the feedback information not only on the term frequency but also on the deep semantic structures. To calculate the feedback values based on semantic structures, a modifying relations knowledge base (MRKB) is used to measure the similarity between the term in relevant document and the term to be expanded. We propose a method to calculate and adjust the term weight. Experiment shows that our method got higher performance than the baseline when applying to the product review dataset.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of Association Rules Mining Based on Restricted Conditional Probability Distribution
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are excessive and disordered rules generated by traditional approaches of association rule mining, many of which are redundant, so that they are difficult for users to understand and make use of. Agrawal et al pointed out the bottleneck of transaction number increase association rules according to the index increase. To solve this problem, a new method was represented, which is based on restricted conditional probability distribution to get a condensed rules set by removing redundant rules. Our set of rules is more meaningful, more concise and users are interested in than others. Especially, the number of rules in rules-set has been reduced greatly. We find that it is an effective method of association rules mining from examples, finally poses future research.

articleTitle: A Behavior-Based Dynamic Trust Model of Virtual Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Virtual organization is a kind of advanced dynamic organizational model which can adapt the competitive market. According to new demands that Virtual organization puts forwards on Trust Model and the lack of current research, we proposed a kind of dynamic trust model of virtual organization which based on behavior. This paper deeply researched and specified follow aspects in Trust Model: the definition, relation attributes, expression, meaning of trust, the variety of trust relation, storage and management of trust database. This work provides a theoretical basis for our future work -- to construct the trust-based access control model.

articleTitle: A Method to Measure the Discriminability of Spatial Cues
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The discriminability of spatial cues refers to the ability of the auditory system to catch any change of sounds. For half a century there were many methods to measure the Just Noticeable Difference(JND) which represents the sensitivity of spatial cue by audio system. The JND should be obtained by a large number of experiments and the results were much various by different people in different experiment condition. This article describes a new method which is an adaptive procedure implemented by computer. The test value can approach the target value fast according to the response of subjects by this adaptive mechanism. This method was adopted in two experiments in order to obtain the JNDs of ILD and ITD. We also compare with the method we proposed and others in speed to target value.

articleTitle: Overlay Multicast Routing Supported by IP Multicast Routers
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We propose TOMIMN as a novel overlay multicast approach, which exploits the support from IP multicast routers to construct a topology-aware overlay tree. Compared with most overlay multicast schemes, TOMIMN tree is compatible with the physical network and effective in saving bandwidth resource. Due to the network layer support, no complicated algorithm is needed to adjust the overlay topology in response to membership changes. On the other hand, TOMIMN tree can cover members in unicast domains, which don't support IP Multicast routing. By simulations, we show that TOMIMN draws a good balance between traditional overlay and IP multicast approaches.

articleTitle: Partners Portfolio Decision-Making Model Based on the Fuzzy Evaluation and Polychromatic Sets
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to design an enterprise's own supply chain, the portfolio decision-making model for supply chain partners is proposed based on polychromatic sets and fuzzy evaluation. First, the evaluation value of the supply chain members is given, Then, to avoid factor's non-balance evaluation problem of the fuzzy evaluation, supply chain members collaborative relationship is qualitatively chosen according to the supply chain management model, Finally, in the portfolio selection phase of the supply chain partners, from the relationship of the roles and cooperation between partners in the supply chain, the coordination of supply chain is achieved by assigning to different variables for partners. And a case is given to illustrate the detailed process of using this method to make a rational relationship of supply chain.

articleTitle: Research and Application on the Means of Transparent Texture Anti-aliasing
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To solve the flicker problem of the fuzzy edge of the transparent texture, this article analyses the reasons of the texture aliasing, introduces the current anti-aliasing skills which are popular, and the making technique of transparent texture combines with the practical application of 3D simulation, proposes a new anti-aliasing technique which aims at the transparent texture, Its principle is to add the same color of the texture on the model surface, reduce the grayscale difference, eliminate the scintillation from the visual. It solves the difficult problem that computer bring the edge blurry twinkle when the real-time plans the transparent texture, the method has a significance to the general computer 3D simulation enthusiasts and researchers.

articleTitle: Correlation Analyses among Ionosphere Disturbance, Ground Electric Field Variation and Thunderstorm Activity
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the work of statistical analysis software SPSS, through curve estimation, linear correlation, partial correlation and stepwise regression, we make a correlation analysis among ionosphere disturbance, ground electric variation and thunderstorm activity. We also look into the influence from ionosphere and ground electric field on thunderstorm activity instantly, ionosphere disturbance has extremely significant influence on thunderstorm current. The correlation between ground electric field and thunderstorm activity is negative. On the other hand, in multi-factor interplay analyses, thunderstorm activity is largely affected by ionosphere disturbance within 3 hours. Between electric field and thunderstorm current, the partial correlation is negative which increases from significant to extremely-significant in the time span from the 4th hour to the 7th hour.

articleTitle: Improved Joint ICI Cancellation and Error Correction for OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is attractive for high data rate transmission due to spectral efficiency but is known to be sensitive to synchronization errors(symbol time and frequency offset)[1]. Mobility is the basic feature of most of present day techniques that employs OFDM at the backend but Doppler frequencies generated due to the mobility causes frequency offsets which results in Inter Carrier Interference (ICI) amongst the subcarriers of the multicarrier OFDM technique. It induces cross talk and causes deterioration of signal. This paper proposes an efficient Frequency-domain ICI mitigation technique based on the estimation of channel taps to vanish the effects of channel frequency offsets from the proposed OFDM model. Along with this, the channel induced noise tend to raise the BER of the OFDM system making it unsuitable for many error-sensitive applications. Turbo codes have been integrated into the resulting system to cater-for the effects of channel induced noise. MAP decoding algorithm applied at the receiving end is based on the exchange of soft information amongst the component decoders that gain from eachother's interleaved extrinsic information. The signal is passed through multipath Rayleigh fading AWGN channel and the performance is measured.

articleTitle: Novel Network Primitives for Overlay Multicasting
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We propose two novel network layer primitives, and later adopted them as the foundation for implementing our NTAG overlay multicast protocol. The notion of NTAG originates from its former version of TAG, which exploits network topology information to optimize the overlay tree in terms of delay penalty and link stress. However, NTAG has prominent advantages over traditional approaches. Unlike multicasting at the network layer, the novel primitives only belong to the control path and avoid problems pertaining to IP multicast. On the other hand, the network support significantly reduces the complexity of the overlay multicast routing algorithm. Through a large amount of simulations, we have proven that NTAG is not only efficient in its overlay transmission but also effective when supported in an incremental manner.

articleTitle: Analysis on Incentive Mechanism of Human Resources Dispatching under Moral Hazard
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the increasing of market competition, human dispatching service can reduce enterprise's human resources cost. But asymmetric information among principal, dispatching agency and dispatched workers may cause moral hazard of dispatching agency and dispatched workers. This paper considers moral hazard under asymmetric information. It researches the maximum problem of principal's profit under the incentive compatibility constraints of considering dispatching agency and dispatched workers. Through model analysis it commissioned that principal can adjust the incentive coefficient in order to better motivate dispatching agency and dispatched workers, so that the requester to obtain more revenue.

articleTitle: A Novel OFDM Spreading System with Spatial Domain Processing and MMSE-MUD
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel scheme that joints two-level spreading OFDM and beam forming. For further interference suppression, we assign a proper spreading code at transmitter and employ the Minimum Mean Square Error - MUltiuser Detection (MMSE-MUD) equalizer at receiver. Simulation results show that the proposed system outperforms the conventional two-level spreading OFDM system under multipath fading and narrow band jamming channels.

articleTitle: Multihomed Multicasting by Overlay Proxies
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compared with traditional IP Multicast, overlay multicast is not only flexible in functionality but also compatible with current network infrastructure. Therefore it is emerging as an effective solution for most group communications over the Internet. Affected by end-host overlay systems, the overlay multicast routing problem is studied under a single homed model in most literatures. Under this model each MSN (multicast service node) only has one access link to the Internet. This is no longer applicable to those fixed MSN, which may have multiple access links to the physical network. In order to solve the problem correctly, we propose a multihomed proxy model in this paper to describe the overlay network more accurately. We also develop a general solution to the routing problem under our model, which includes a path selection process and a multicast routing process. In the end we design an OMMP (overlay multicast over multihomed proxy) architecture, which integrates all MSNs into one framework to realize the overlay multicast service under our model.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Digital Image Hiding Based on Ellipse Curve
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The article points to the research of digital image information hiding, the definition of ellipse curve and finite region is introduced, the addition operation character of ellipse curve on finite region is discussed, the idiographic operation method and its result is also discussed. Experiment result shows the theory and application of ellipse curve on finite region F(2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>) used in digital image information hiding, and demonstrates the feasibility of decryption process in theory.

articleTitle: The Application of Improved DMC in Remote Networked Measure-Control System
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problems of network delay, time series disorder and packets dropout in Internet Networked Measure-Control system, an improved DMC predictive control model was built which used time series analysis method. For solving time series disorder and packets dropout, the time series compositor and interpolation method were applied. For reducing the effect of time delay of feedback channels to the whole system, an improved DMC predictive control was presented, and applying the Nth step information sequence control of the multi-step predictive control to solve time delay of forward channels. The whole system was simulated by MATLAB/TRUETIME, and the experiment results demonstrate the feasibility of the improved DMC method applying to solve the above problems.

articleTitle: Research of MTS Method Based on Vague Set
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: MTS is a pattern recognition method and it can only achieve a single category of identification. But Multi-class pattern recognition problem are most common in the process of pattern recognition. As decision-maker's cognition of things is vague and uncertain and vague set is an effective way to deal with uncertainty problem, so the author tries to combine vague set with MTS to construct Multi-class pattern recognition model and give a specific steps of algorithm.

articleTitle: Schistosoma cercariae Image Recognition Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Schistosomiasis is infectious and parasitic diseases with serious hazards. It will contribute to the prevention and treatment of schistosomiasis to establish an automatic monitoring and identifying system for the schistosomacercariae. Schistosoma cercariae's swing, the complexity of their environment and so on are increasing the difficulty of the schist some cercariae image recognition. In this paper, we extract schist soma cercariae's morphological characteristics and establish a three-layer BP network B (8, 3, 1) to recognize schist some cercariae image. Experimental results show that the method is effective. Experimental recognition rate can reach 92.86%.

articleTitle: Capacitive Micro-accelerometer PSPICE Simulation Model Research
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: During the process of establishing the capacitivmicro-accelerometer PSPICE Simulation Model, consider in the precise electrical model of the capacitance, According tthe characteristics of MEMS capacitance, established micraccelerometer PSPICE simulation model. In the model, thelectrical and mechanical coupling process of Capacitiv MEMS sensor was analyzed. By using this simulation mode the closed-loop detection circuit was simulated by PSPICE The simulation results show that the closed-loop capacitanc detection circuit can effectively improve the linearity and thmeasure range of the capacitive micro-accelerometer, it caeliminate mechanical resonance. But the closed-loop system' stability and response speed must be ensured. Therefore, the stablishment of capacitive micro-accelerometer PSPIC simulation model is very valuable to the design and simulatio of the closed-loop capacitive detection circuit.

articleTitle: The Research of Emotion Space and Its Migration Mechanisms on the Comprehensive Information Emotional Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper firstly introduced the basic content of the comprehensive information emotional theory, which includes: basic model, basic principle, emotional changes produced by cognition fall, and then further discussed emotion space (feeling, emotion and affection space), emotional stimulus response threshold, migration mechanisms and rules of emotion space. The changes of emotional state (migration of emotion space) and cognition process and the relation between them were unveiled.

articleTitle: Real-Time Corner Detection Algorithm Based on GPU
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a class of GPU-based real-time corner detection algorithms. On the basis of existing corner detection algorithms, GPU-based real-time corner detection algorithms are executed by GPU. To further improve the speed of the algorithm, the algorithm uses the method of corner value map compression. Experiments show that the GPU-based real time corner detection algorithm is suited to the real-time applications with resolution up to 1024 * 768 pixels.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Decision Analysis of the Software Configuration Management Tools Selection
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Configuration management tool play an important role in software project management, it can solve a lot of problems which trouble the software project managers, Configuration management tool selection involve in many factors, it is a multifactor, complex systems engineering problem. In this paper, use the method of fuzzy decision analysis to study. First, analysis the evaluation indicators of the configuration management tool, use the decision hierarchy diagram to analysis the function, performance, cost, service and other indicators, where after, study multi-objective fuzzy decision method, including constructing the factors index matrix, constructing the fuzzy matrix, and making decisions on programs, finally, use the configuration management tool to select the instance, explain the whole process of decision analysis methods. The results show that, fuzzy decision analysis method well solves the fuzzy and non-deterministic problem, in the configuration management tool selection, practical application should be using qualitative analysis and quantitative calculated combining method, flexibility to determine the evaluation index system and its weights value.

articleTitle: 3D Digital Basin in Hydraulic Education
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The hydropower simulation in the Virtual Reality (VR) demonstration environment has not been available in applications. This paper applies OpenGL and VRML to establish virtual 3D digital basin of which the information, in different environments, can be displayed to visualizing spatial information of basins, hydropower station discharging and flood disaster effect. With the support of 3D digital basin, simulation teaching of the engineering hydrology courses have been carried out, the results of course evaluation indicate that simulation teaching mode has more advantages over traditional teaching mode in teaching effect, such as providing more practical simulation and developing learning ability improvement.

articleTitle: Review on Performance of Construction Project Manager
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an important part of construction project management, the performance of construction project manager is also a hotspot in manager's performance theory and human resource management of construction enterprises. This paper reviews the research on structural elements, evaluation indicators and evaluation methods of performance of construction project manager. And then it discusses their characteristics and disadvantages. Finally it describes their current trends.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Factors Influencing the Quality of Internet Banking Service
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the factors of affecting perceived service quality of internet banking. The framework of perceived service quality is constructed on the basis of theoretical research and China's reality. And the framework is tested by LISREL8.7.This paper also puts forward the suggestions of enhancing perceived service quality of internet banking.

articleTitle: Credit Soft Budget Constraint and the Goal Difference
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: From the relevant interest game, this article establishes a tripartite game model involving enterprise, bank and government to analyze their behavior and their goal difference of how to influence the enterprise credit default. The model shows that for political and economic interests, the government implements the soft budget constraint to enterprise repayment through subsidies to bank and enterprise.

articleTitle: RFID Integration Re-engineering of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to improve the information collection, transmission and processing efficiency of supply chain RFID system through RFID Integration Reengineering (RIR) of supply chain. In order to obtain the best results, RIR process not only focus on improvement and process reengineering of the RFID system itself, but also need to carry out systematic Business Process Reengineering (BPR) along the throughout supply chain. So, the RIR framework which is a systematic reengineering process involved in all supply chain elements is proposed and discussed in this paper. Object-Oriented Analysis (OOA) methods can be used for RFID systems integration and analysis in RFID Process Reengineering (RPR). And simulation can be used for assessment of the Supply Chain RIR process. RIR is of great significance for improving the level of RFID innovations, election and operation.

articleTitle: User Interest Model Create and Update in Personalized Search Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Proposed a new model of user interest create and update methods. This method uses the Web content mining and user behavior analysis to create a user model, and by moving the time window to update the user model.

articleTitle: Dynamic Information Management and Control Methods Based on Visual Simulation for Water-Power Engineering of Nanchang Bonded Logistics Park
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development of computer and system simulation technologies allows the dynamic process of water-power engineering to be simulated in real time on the computer, and the advanced visual method can reflects the simulation result by direct images. The reasons of deviation can be analyzed on the basis of comparison of estimation and plan, so as to provide the scientific, direct and high efficient information for decision-making in the engineering management, correct the plan and guarantee the engineering is completed successfully. For the water-power engineering of Nanchang Bonded Logistics Park, the paper has brought forward the dynamic management and control methods based on visual simulation for the water power engineering, and mainly researched the visual-simulation-based schedule control and real-time cost control.

articleTitle: A Method for Exporting Relational Schema into Document Type Definition
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A method is proposed for publishing relational data into extensional markup language (XML). First, the characteristics of relational schemas represented by Entity-Relation (E-R) diagrams and XML document type definitions (DTDs) are analyzed. Secondly, the corresponding mapping rules are proposed. At last an algorithm based on edge tables is presented, which has two key points: one is that edge table is used to store the information of relational dictionary, the other is that structural information can be obtained from the resulting DTDs and other applications can optimize their query process using the structural information.

articleTitle: Blind Experiment Based on Dynamic Approximate Entropy Measure for Quasi-brain-death EEG
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) based preliminary examination has been proposed in the clinical brain death determination. In the EEG signal analysis process, Approximate Entropy (ApEn) as a complexity based method appears to have potential for the application to physiological and clinical time-series data. In our previous studies, in the condition of knowing about the clinical state of patients from the standard process of brain-death diagnosis, the same results could be obtained by using our developed ApEn measure for quasi-brain-death EEG. In this paper, we present this dynamic complexity measure based blind experiment without knowing about the clinical symptoms of patients beforehand. Features obtained from three typical cases indicate one patient being in coma and the other changing from com to quasi-brain-death. Being identical to further clinical diagnose, results of thirteen cases from nine patients illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed method and implies its significance of a reference for brain death diagnosis in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Combined Use of Double Weather Radar in Weather Modification
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, Doppler weather radar has been widely used in China. Many areas have been provided with Doppler weather radar, and utilize the internet to interconnect the original data or image data. But interconnected data is usually PPI, and also affected by the scanning elevation and scanning speed, so there are some blind areas at the time of detecting severe convective weather near the sites. This paper mainly discusses the feasibility of using the operating parameters extracted from interconnected Doppler weather radar's PPI images to control X-band weather radar, and make RHI scanning in oder to perfect observation of blind areas and improve the monitoring of severe convective weather.

articleTitle: Study and Implementation of an Online Visual Design Tool for Web Pages
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Design and development of web pages were traditionally conducted by professional staff, which usually can't satisfy various users' individual requirement. Therefore, the study of a highly efficient, personalized, and visual design tool for web pages is of great importance and value. After giving a comparison of several common web design tools and techniques, the paper chooses EXTJS technique to develop a novel design tool for web pages. The tool is based on Internet browser and B/S architecture. Through utilizing the advantages of EXTJS technique and data cache mechanism, the tool achieves modulization and visual design of web pages. As a result, the tool provides a new way for web site development at present.

articleTitle: Trust Model of Software Behaviors Based on Check Point Risk Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to evaluate the credibility of software behaviors more reasonably and accurately, a trust model of software behaviors based on check point risk evaluation is presented. Firstly, adopt fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) to figure out the weight of every risk factor of check point, meanwhile, assess the modules value according to Markov Chain Usage Model, thus calculating out the risk value of check point and accumulating every suspected risk check point, and then adopt rewarding or punishment mechanism to evaluate a software behaviors trustworthy, which can judge whether software behaviors are credible or not. The simulated experiment shows that this model can distinguish the potential risk effectively in software behaviors, evaluate the risk value trustworthy and provide objective and reliable information to judge whether software behaviors are credible or not.

articleTitle: Cost Allocation of Jointly-Managed Inventory Based on Cooperative Game and Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 Third International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Integrated supply (I/S) by third-party logistics is an effective way to reduce supply-chain cost. The key problem of I/S is to allocate the joint inventory cost among the suppliers. In this paper, a cost-allocating method is put forward based on cooperative game theory and data envelopment analysis to work out a rational allocation ratio for each supplier. The input-output contributions for each participator are taken into account to ensure more equitable and rational results. Finally, an example is used to testify that this method is exercisable and reasonable.
